noise_policy: same standardized proper complex AWGN atom per trajectory/repeat/frame across 10/20dB, variance scaling only
noise_rationale: paired receiver-noise atoms isolate SNR scaling; independent draws across repeats and frames; overlapping windows reuse their physical frame noise
seed_rule: 3600000000 + 10000*trajectory_id + 100*repeat_id + frame_id; receiver AWGN role only; no SNR offset because atoms paired; distinct from U2B channel/bit/noise namespace; no search
hypotheses_verbatim:
## H1 — Negative penalty persistence

如果 SP-U2B 的负 ΔR_noise
不仅是 single-noise accident，

则对于一部分固定 trajectory/window，

20个独立 noise repeats 的：

\[
E_r[\Delta R_{\rm noise}]
\]

应稳定为负。

### Supporting

trajectory/window conditional mean
在相当一部分 cases 下负，

且 negative fraction
明显高于随机近50%的纯符号波动模式。

### Contradicting

conditional means 大多接近0，

SP-U2B 高 negative count
主要由单 draw 造成。

---

## H2 — Oracle-directed movement

如果 negative penalty 来自
noise-CV movement
朝 oracle 方向移动，

则：

\[
C_r
\]

应经常为负，

且 negative-penalty repeats
应具有更负的：

\[
\cos_M.
\]

### Supporting

conditional mean cross term 为负，

且能够解释 Q 被抵消。

### Contradicting

cross-term signs 随机，
negative penalty 无稳定 geometry。

---

## H3 — Excitation predicts conditional noise variance

对于固定 clean window，

定义：

\[
V_c
=
E_r
\|
c_r-c_0
\|^2.
\]

或 empirical repeat RMS：

\[
RMS_c
=
\sqrt{
\frac1{20}
\sum_r
\|c_r-c_0\|^2
}.
\]

如果 SP-U2B 的 excitation sensitivity
不是 single-draw artifact，

则：

\[
\sigma_{\min}(G_0)
\downarrow
\]

应对应：

\[
RMS_c
\uparrow.
\]

这是本轮比 single-noise norm
更重要的 stability diagnostic。

---

## H4 — Condition number remains secondary

预期：

clean absolute excitation

比：

clean \(\kappa_G\)

更稳定地解释 repeat RMS coordinate displacement。

如果结果相反，

必须修改 SP-U2B interpretation。

---

## H5 — Surrogate gap remains non-negligible

即便对 noise repeats 平均，

clean-CV 到 per-repeat channel oracle 的
M-metric risk gap

仍可能大于
noise-coordinate contribution。

如果成立：

不得把 Paper 1 主要 limitation
归结为 coefficient noise sensitivity。

numerical_cosine_rule: Es=s^T M s, En=n^T M n; undefined if Es<=64*eps*max(1,||M||2*||s||2^2) or En<=64*eps*max(1,||M||2*||n||2^2); save null, thresholds and undefined counts; never drop records or clip cosine
borderline_rule: abs(deltaR)<=2e-10*max(1,abs(Q)+abs(C),R,R0); preserve exact computed signs plus borderline flag
representative_rule: within each SNR, choose negative and positive conditional-mean windows closest to population median; ties trajectory ID then frame ID; no scientific subject selection
analysis: 120 conditional windows/SNR; primary cross-channel association Spearman of six-window trajectory means (n=20); repeat RMS, Vc, empirical covariance; no p-values, bootstrap or formal CI
persistence_descriptors: report negative fractions >0.5, >=0.75 and =1; these are descriptive counts, not significance thresholds; first10/last10 mean signs reported prospectively
decision_rule: user A/B/C qualitative rules; no invented scientific cutoff; systematic conditional effect requires coherent repeat persistence and negative oracle-cross explanation; otherwise mixed or mostly single-draw; no universal conclusion
plots: at most six A-F; C includes all 240 fixed windows x 20 repeats for Q,C,delta heatmaps plus conditional mean Q-vs-C
